plan.usage: plan takes new | list | show | part | finalize | close | reopen | adopt | add | link | set | rm | accept | reject | drift | drift-stats | review
plan.badSlug: Plan name "{slug}" is not valid: use 1-40 characters from a-z, 0-9 and -
plan.noNode: No plan node "{node}" (use an id such as n2, or Lnn for a line without an id)
plan.tooMany: A plan holds at most {max} nodes
plan.tooDeep: Plans nest at most {max} levels deep
plan.hasChildren: Node {node} has children; remove or move them first (rm takes a leaf only)
plan.tooBig: Plan {slug} is larger than {max} KiB; split it before changing it
plan.notFound: No plan named "{slug}" (see: crew plan list)
plan.notProposed: Node {node} is not a proposed node; accept only applies to [?]
plan.clarifyEmpty: A clarified line needs both --question and --answer.
plan.noGoal: Warning: this plan has no goal, so nothing can tell when the work drifts away from it. Add a goal line under the title in the plan file.
plan.empty: No plans. Start one with: crew plan new SLUG --title "..."
plan.head: {slug}: {title}  {pct}% ({done}/{total} steps done)
plan.truncated: (the plan is larger than the display limit; only the first part is shown)
plan.dupIds: Warning: these ids are used more than once (the first one wins; the next write gives the others new ids): {ids}
plan.review.usage: plan review takes run | submit | filter | finalize | show
plan.review.dispatch: Dispatch the {agent} subagent (model {model}) for plan {slug}, plan review round {round}, with the prompt below (Agent tool, read-only).
plan.review.rawAt: The findings will be stored as {path}
plan.review.thenFilter: When it has saved its findings, run: crew plan review filter {slug}
plan.review.filtered: Plan review round {round}: {total} findings, {kept} kept, {dropped} dropped
plan.review.nothingToRefute: Nothing left to refute. Close the round with: crew plan review finalize {slug}
plan.review.finalized: Plan review round {round}: {n} proposed nodes added ({refuted} refuted, {cut} cut by the per-round limit)
plan.review.deepNote: note: {id} would nest deeper than {max} levels, so it was attached under {under} (the deepest allowed level)
plan.review.decide: Decide each one: crew plan accept {slug} <node>   or   crew plan reject {slug} <node> --note "why"
plan.review.roundRow: Round {round} ({date}, {status}): raised {raised}, refuted {refuted}, kept {kept}, cut {cut}, accepted {accepted}, rejected {rejected}
plan.review.accepted.add: Node {id} accepted: it is now an open step
plan.review.accepted.split: Node {id} accepted: it is now an open step
plan.review.accepted.change: Node {id} accepted: step {target} was reworded and the proposal removed
plan.review.accepted.drop: Node {id} accepted: step {target} is dropped and the proposal removed
plan.review.rejected: Node {id} rejected; later review rounds will not raise it again
plan.review.growth: Plan {slug} has grown by {count} accepted proposals since the last large_task approval (limit {limit}). The large_task gate applies: ask the user first (crew gate ask large_task), then record the answer.
planReview.maxRounds: Plan {slug} has had {max} plan review rounds already (plan.max_rounds); add --force to run another
planReview.alreadyFinalized: Plan review round {round} is already finalized; start a new round with: crew plan review run
planReview.noRefutations: No refutations for round {round} yet (submit them with --kind refutations, or pass --refutations-file)
planReview.targetGone: Proposal {node} is about step {target}, which is gone or dropped; reject it instead
planReview.unknownRound: Plan review round {round} was not started with "crew plan review run"; start one first
planReview.targetChanged: Proposal {node} was reviewed against an earlier wording of step {target}, which has changed since; reject it and run a new review round
plan.problem.goal: the goal is empty (the line under the title)
plan.problem.not_doing: the Not doing part is empty (plan part SLUG not-doing "...")
plan.problem.done_when: the Done when part is empty (plan part SLUG done-when "...")
plan.problem.steps: there are no steps (plan add SLUG "...")
plan.problem.assumed: a Clarified line ends in (assumed): ask the user and record the answer with --by user
plan.isLegacy: Plan {slug} has no state (a legacy plan). Make it a draft first: crew plan adopt {slug}
plan.notDraft: Plan {slug} is {state}, not a draft. Reopen it first to change it: crew plan reopen {slug}
plan.notFinal: Plan {slug} is {state}; only a final plan can be closed
plan.notReopenable: Plan {slug} is {state}; only a final, done or parked plan can be reopened
plan.noTitleLine: Plan {slug} has no title line (# Title); add one before it can get a state
plan.notLegacy: Plan {slug} is {state}; only a legacy plan (no state line) can be adopted
plan.badGate: Gate {id} is not the pending ask of plan {slug}. Ask again: crew plan finalize {slug}
plan.gateNo: The user said no. Plan {slug} stays as it is.
plan.noUserTurn: Refused: no user message came after the ask (gate {id}). Show plan {slug} to the user, end your turn, and ask again after they reply.
plan.changedSinceAsk: Plan {slug} changed after the user was asked: they approved the earlier text. Ask again: crew plan finalize {slug}
plan.badPart: Unknown part "{part}": use not-doing or done-when
plan.partEmpty: The text of the part is empty
plan.badClose: Close takes done or parked, not "{to}"
plan.finalizeAsked: Gate {id} asked for plan {slug}. Show the whole plan to the user in chat and end your turn. After they reply yes, run: crew plan finalize {slug} --gate {id}. If they say no, run: crew gate answer {id} no. Do not edit the plan meanwhile: an edit needs a new approval.
plan.closeAsked: Gate {id} asked to close plan {slug} as {to}. Ask the user in chat and end your turn. After they reply yes, run: crew plan close {slug} {to} --gate {id}
plan.reopenedOk: Plan {slug} is a draft again. Finalizing it asks the user again.
plan.stateConflict: Warning: the plan file says {file} but the record says {record}. The files disagree; the record wins.
plan.driftNotFinal: Plan {slug} is {state}; drift is only asked about a final plan
plan.driftBadGate: Gate {id} is not a drift ask of plan {slug}. Ask again: crew plan drift {slug} --kind ...
plan.driftTextShape: The text for "{answer}" would become a heading, a list item or a step in the plan file: "{text}". Give it as plain words. Nothing was changed and the gate is not used up.
plan.driftAlreadyAnswered: Gate {id} was already used for a drift answer. Ask again if the plan drifted again.
plan.driftAsked: Gate {id} asked about drift (kind {kind}) from plan {slug}. Tell the user in chat what happened, offer these answers, and end your turn:
plan.driftAnswer.add: add    - add it to the plan as a step the user asked for (the answer is the approval; no new finalize)
plan.driftAnswer.goal: goal   - change the plan's goal line to the text (no new finalize)
plan.driftAnswer.new: new    - start a new draft plan named by the text (slug); this plan does not change
plan.driftAnswer.drop: drop   - do not do it: the text goes under ## Not doing
plan.driftAnswer.defer: defer  - later: the text becomes a to-do item in stream drift
plan.driftNext: After they reply, run: crew plan drift {slug} --gate {id} --answer add|goal|new|drop|defer --text "...". If they say no, run: crew gate answer {id} no, and change nothing.
plan.driftNewStep: Plan {slug} is final: adding a step changes what the user approved, so nothing was changed. Ask them first: run crew plan drift {slug} --kind new-step --detail "..." (say what step and why), end your turn, and after they reply run crew plan drift {slug} --gate <gate id> --answer add|goal|new|drop|defer --text "...". Then add the step again.
plan.driftUnasked: Warning: plan {slug} is final and this step was added without asking the user (plan.enforce=remind). Ask them: crew plan drift {slug} --kind new-step --detail "...".
plan.driftUnlinkedTask: No task was created: a plan is final in this project ({slugs}) and this task has no plan. Link it with --plan <slug>:<node>, or ask the user first: run crew plan drift {slug} --kind unlinked-task --detail "..." (say what the task is and why), end your turn, and after they reply run crew plan drift {slug} --gate <gate id> --answer add|goal|new|drop|defer --text "...", then create the task again. For an unrelated small fix that needs no reply: --outside-plan "reason".
plan.driftUnlinkedWarn: Warning: a plan is final in this project ({slugs}) and this task was created without a plan (plan.enforce=remind). Ask the user: crew plan drift {slug} --kind unlinked-task --detail "...", or use --plan <slug>:<node> or --outside-plan "reason".
